scope: All taxonomy terms; excludes non-taxonomy routes.

state_definitions.researching: Sources are being inspected and evidence collected.
state_definitions.drafting: Content is being written from inspected evidence.
state_definitions.validating: JSON, citations, hierarchy, datasets, and diagrams are being checked.
state_definitions.ready_for_review: Validation is complete; editorial review is pending.
state_definitions.complete: Editorial review is complete and the final output is recorded.

scheduling.strategy: Taxonomy depth-first order, parents before descendants, three pages per batch.
instructions: Process batches in order; consult ancestor pages for context.
Update term states individually; a batch may contain terms at different stages.
Mark a batch ready_for_review only when all its terms are ready_for_review or complete; mark complete only when every term is complete.
Record evidence gaps in blockers or notes and use needs_research when core claims remain unsupported.
Record output_file and timestamps as work actually occurs.
Do not treat this schedule as verified research or publication-ready content.
